workbuddy-cloud-turns.title: Continue collaboration
workbuddy-cloud-turns.intro: Explicitly send one follow-up input to the original cloud session. This does not create a new cloud task. The provider manages the model and usage.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.read_scope: Only you can read this collaboration content. Access to the public task is separate.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.acknowledged_promp: The original input has been recorded. This does not mean remote execution has completed.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.acknowledged_comma: The original control operation has been recorded. Delivery confirmation does not prove tool completion or remote shutdown.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.unknown_prompt: The original input result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation with its unchanged content and operation ID; do not resend the input.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.unknown_command: The original control result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation with its unchanged content and operation ID; do not resend the decision.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.access_changed: Your access has changed. Protected collaboration content has been cleared.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.invalid_read: The returned collaboration content does not match the current account, project, or original turn. Reload it.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.read_failed: The current collaboration content could not be confirmed.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.limit: The content limit for this read has been reached. Retain the content already read and check the original turn.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.no_turn: No collaboration turn has been read yet
workbuddy-cloud-turns.completed_hint: The response turn matched to this input has ended. Task delivery, code, independent testing, and human acceptance still require separate verification.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.stopped_hint: This turn's result is unconfirmed. Do not resend the input. This state does not prove that remote execution has stopped.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.overdue: This turn timed out or its connection can no longer be confirmed. Verify the current result.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.coverage_hint: Only saved records are shown. They do not represent the complete session or all remote activity.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.empty: This turn has no saved records available to display yet.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.unsupported: This record cannot currently be displayed safely.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.details_unavailabl: The operation details cannot be displayed in full. Allow once is disabled; you can still reject this request.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.once_only: Only allow-once and reject-once decisions are available here. Ongoing authorization is not offered.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.cancel_hint: Cancellation applies only to this turn. Delivery confirmation does not mean the original cloud task or remote process has stopped.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.reconcile_hint: This only checks the local state after contact was lost. It sends no request to the provider and does not authorize another input.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.prompt_hint: Once explicitly sent, this input goes only to the original cloud session. If its result is unconfirmed, check the original operation without resending it.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.prompt_limit: The input exceeds the length limit. Shorten it before sending.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.execution_unavaila: The current run version has not been confirmed. Refresh the original run first.
workbuddy-cloud-turns.usage.partial: Partial usage observations only; not a complete bill
workbuddy-cloud-turns.usage.unreported: Usage unreported; this does not mean zero consumption
workbuddy-cloud-turns.error.workbuddy_cl: This turn's result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation without resending it.
Collaboration was interrupted. Existing records are retained; the remote result still needs verification.
Collection reached its limit. Earlier records are retained; they do not establish that all work completed.
The original collaboration authorization or source has changed. This operation cannot continue; check your current eligibility.
This operation was rejected before execution. Check the current content and permissions.
This turn cannot continue right now. Refresh and check its original state.
